title: Instability of two-dimensional Taylor-Green Vortices
summary: For a wide class of linear Hamiltonian operators we develop a general criterion that characterizes the unstable eigenvalues as the zeros of a holomorphic function given by the determinant of a finite-dimensional matrix. We apply the latter result to prove the spectral instability of the Taylor-Green vortex in two-dimensional ideal fluids. The linearized Euler operator at this steady state possesses different invariant subspaces, within which we apply our criterion to rule out or detect instabilities.
